blazor middle-truncation: Documented deviation in MiddleTruncation.md: C# measures no pixel width, so MaxCharacters is a character budget. Fitting the container needs a JS module (tasks.md P23-T16 stage 7).
angular prop autosuggest.onInput: The Angular output is `query`; `input` would shadow the native event.
angular prop cascader.onSelect: The Angular output is `selectionChange`; `select` would shadow the native event.
angular prop clipboard-copy-button.onerr: The Angular output is `copyError`; `error` would shadow the native event.
angular prop mentions-input.onSelect: The Angular output is `mention`; `select` would shadow the native event.
angular prop tree-select.onSelect: The Angular output is `selectionChange`; `select` would shadow the native event.
angular prop tool-call.summary: Projected as `[toolCallSummary]`: a `[summary]` selector would read as the native <summary>.
